17: /-! ## (1) O bit da verdade: V(b, b̂) = 1 − (b − b̂)² -/

19: /-- A valoracao da atribuicao binaria. -/
20: def truthValue (b bh : ℤ) : ℤ := 1 - (b - bh) ^ 2
21: 
22: theorem truthValue_table :
23:     truthValue 1 1 = 1 ∧ truthValue 0 0 = 1 ∧ truthValue 1 0 = 0 ∧ truthValue 0 1 = 0 := by
24:   refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩ <;> norm_num [truthValue]
25: 
26: theorem truthBit_eq_one_iff (b bh : ℤ) (hb : b = 0 ∨ b = 1) (hbh : bh = 0 ∨ bh = 1) :
27:     truthValue b bh = 1 ↔ b = bh := by
28:   rcases hb with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hbh with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num [truthValue]
29: 
30: theorem truthBit_eq_zero_iff (b bh : ℤ) (hb : b = 0 ∨ b = 1) (hbh : bh = 0 ∨ bh = 1) :
31:     truthValue b bh = 0 ↔ b ≠ bh := by
32:   rcases hb with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hbh with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num [truthValue]
33: 
34: /-- Nos bits, V so assume 0 ou 1 (e bivalente). -/
35: theorem truthBit_bivalent (b bh : ℤ) (hb : b = 0 ∨ b = 1) (hbh : bh = 0 ∨ bh = 1) :
36:     truthValue b bh = 0 ∨ truthValue b bh = 1 := by
37:   rcases hb with rfl | rfl <;> rcases hbh with rfl | rfl <;> norm_num [truthValue]

39: /-! ## (2) Os tres vinculos: ker (Σ D_j† D_j) = ⋂ ker D_j -/
40: 
41: section Penalty
42: 
43: variable {𝕜 E : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E]
44:   [CompleteSpace E]
45: 
46: /-- A penalidade dos vinculos: H = Σ_j D_j† D_j. -/
47: noncomputable def penalty {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (D : ι → E →L[𝕜] E) : E →L[𝕜] E :=
48:   ∑ j, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (D j) * D j
49: 
50: theorem re_inner_adjoint_mul_self (A : E →L[𝕜] E) (x : E) :
51:     RCLike.re ⟪x, (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint A * A) x⟫_𝕜 = ‖A x‖ ^ 2 := by
52:   rw [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint_inner_right,
53:     inner_self_eq_norm_sq]
54: 
55: /-- A forma quadratica da penalidade e a soma dos quadrados dos defeitos. -/
56: theorem re_inner_penalty {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (D : ι → E →L[𝕜] E) (x : E) :
57:     RCLike.re ⟪x, penalty D x⟫_𝕜 = ∑ j, ‖D j x‖ ^ 2 := by
58:   simp only [penalty, ContinuousLinearMap.sum_apply, inner_sum, map_sum]
59:   exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => re_inner_adjoint_mul_self (D j) x
60: 
61: /-- A familia e a exclusao conjunta: ker H = ⋂_j ker D_j (uma violacao nao compensa outra). -/
62: theorem ker_penalty {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (D : ι → E →L[𝕜] E) :
63:     (penalty D).ker = ⨅ j, (D j).ker := by
64:   ext x
65:   simp only [Submodule.mem_iInf, LinearMap.mem_ker]
66:   constructor
67:   · intro h j
68:     have h0 : ∑ j, ‖D j x‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by
69:       have h' : (penalty D) x = 0 := h
70:       rw [← re_inner_penalty, h', inner_zero_right, map_zero]
71:     have hj := (Finset.sum_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg (fun j _ => sq_nonneg ‖D j x‖)).1 h0 j
72:       (Finset.mem_univ _)
73:     exact norm_eq_zero.1 (pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.1 hj)
74:   · intro h
75:     simp [penalty, h]
76: 
77: /-- A forma com tres operadores, literal: ker (D₁†D₁ + D₂†D₂ + D₃†D₃) = ker D₁ ⊓ ker D₂ ⊓ ker D₃. -/
78: theorem ker_threeLocks (D₁ D₂ D₃ : E →L[𝕜] E) :
79:     (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D₁ * D₁ + ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D₂ * D₂
80:         + ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint D₃ * D₃).ker
81:       = D₁.ker ⊓ D₂.ker ⊓ D₃.ker := by
82:   have h := ker_penalty (𝕜 := 𝕜) ![D₁, D₂, D₃]
83:   simp only [penalty, Fin.sum_univ_three, Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_one,
84:     Matrix.cons_val_two, Matrix.head_cons, Matrix.tail_cons] at h
85:   rw [h]
86:   ext x
87:   simp only [Submodule.mem_iInf, Submodule.mem_inf, Fin.forall_fin_succ, IsEmpty.forall_iff,
88:     Matrix.cons_val_zero, Matrix.cons_val_succ, and_true, and_assoc]
89: 
90: /-- A penalidade e auto-adjunta. -/
91: theorem isSelfAdjoint_penalty {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (D : ι → E →L[𝕜] E) :
92:     IsSelfAdjoint (penalty D) := by
93:   unfold penalty
94:   refine isSelfAdjoint_sum _ fun j _ => ?_
95:   rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.star_eq_adjoint]
96:   exact IsSelfAdjoint.star_mul_self (D j)
97: 
98: /-- A seletora apofatica A_C = −H e nao-positiva: Re⟪x, A_C x⟫ ≤ 0. -/
99: theorem selector_nonpos {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (D : ι → E →L[𝕜] E) (x : E) :
100:     RCLike.re ⟪x, (-penalty D) x⟫_𝕜 ≤ 0 := by
101:   rw [ContinuousLinearMap.neg_apply, inner_neg_right, map_neg, re_inner_penalty, neg_nonpos]
102:   exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _
103: 
104: end Penalty

106: /-! ## (3) P H = 0 e H P = 0 para P = projecao ortogonal sobre ker H, H auto-adjunto -/
107: 
108: section Projection
109: 
110: variable {𝕜 E : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E]
111:   [CompleteSpace E]
112: 
113: theorem H_mul_proj (H : E →L[𝕜] E) [H.ker.HasOrthogonalProjection] :
114:     H * H.ker.starProjection = 0 := by
115:   ext x
116:   rw [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply]
117:   exact LinearMap.mem_ker.1 (H.ker.starProjection_apply_mem x)
118: 
119: theorem proj_mul_H (H : E →L[𝕜] E) (hH : IsSelfAdjoint H)
120:     [H.ker.HasOrthogonalProjection] :
121:     H.ker.starProjection * H = 0 := by
122:   ext x
123:   rw [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.zero_apply,
124:     Submodule.starProjection_apply_eq_zero_iff, Submodule.mem_orthogonal]
125:   intro u hu
126:   have e : ⟪H u, x⟫_𝕜 = ⟪u, H x⟫_𝕜 := hH.isSymmetric u x
127:   have hu0 : H u = 0 := LinearMap.mem_ker.1 hu
128:   rw [← e, hu0, inner_zero_left]
129: 
130: end Projection

132: /-! ## (4) P · exp(−sH) = P e a conservacao da leitura I(T_s x) = I(x) -/

134: section Exponential
135: 
136: variable {𝔸 : Type*} [NormedRing 𝔸] [CompleteSpace 𝔸]
137: 
138: /-- Algebra pura: se P A = 0 entao P · exp A = P (pela serie). -/
139: theorem mul_exp_eq_of_mul_eq_zero (𝕂 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕂] [NormedAlgebra 𝕂 𝔸] (P A : 𝔸) (h : P * A = 0) :
140:     P * NormedSpace.exp A = P := by
141:   have hs := (NormedSpace.exp_series_hasSum_exp' (𝕂 := 𝕂) A).mul_left P
142:   have h1 : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => P * ((n !⁻¹ : 𝕂) • A ^ n)) P := by
143:     have hf : (fun n : ℕ => P * ((n !⁻¹ : 𝕂) • A ^ n)) = fun n => if n = 0 then P else 0 := by
144:       funext n
145:       cases n with
146:       | zero => simp
147:       | succ n => simp [pow_succ', ← mul_assoc, h]
148:     rw [hf]
149:     exact hasSum_ite_eq 0 P
150:   exact hs.unique h1
151: 
152: /-- Simetrica: se A P = 0 entao exp A · P = P. -/
153: theorem exp_mul_eq_of_mul_eq_zero (𝕂 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕂] [NormedAlgebra 𝕂 𝔸] (P A : 𝔸) (h : A * P = 0) :
154:     NormedSpace.exp A * P = P := by
155:   have hs := (NormedSpace.exp_series_hasSum_exp' (𝕂 := 𝕂) A).mul_right P
156:   have h1 : HasSum (fun n : ℕ => ((n !⁻¹ : 𝕂) • A ^ n) * P) P := by
157:     have hf : (fun n : ℕ => ((n !⁻¹ : 𝕂) • A ^ n) * P) = fun n => if n = 0 then P else 0 := by
158:       funext n
159:       cases n with
160:       | zero => simp
161:       | succ n => simp [pow_succ, mul_assoc, h]
162:     rw [hf]
163:     exact hasSum_ite_eq 0 P
164:   exact hs.unique h1
165: 
166: end Exponential

168: section Flow
169: 
170: variable {𝕜 E : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E]
171:   [CompleteSpace E]
172: 
173: /-- O fluxo da seletora, com parametro em 𝕜: flow H u = exp(−u H). -/
174: noncomputable def flow (H : E →L[𝕜] E) (u : 𝕜) : E →L[𝕜] E := NormedSpace.exp ((-u) • H)
175: 
176: /-- O semigrupo real: T_s = exp(−s H), s ∈ ℝ lido em 𝕜. -/
177: noncomputable def T (H : E →L[𝕜] E) (s : ℝ) : E →L[𝕜] E := flow H (s : 𝕜)
178: 
179: variable (H : E →L[𝕜] E) (hH : IsSelfAdjoint H) [H.ker.HasOrthogonalProjection]
180: 
181: /-- A leitura: I(x) = P x. -/
182: noncomputable abbrev reading : E →L[𝕜] E := H.ker.starProjection
183: 
184: include hH in
185: theorem proj_mul_flow (u : 𝕜) : reading H * flow H u = reading H := by
186:   refine mul_exp_eq_of_mul_eq_zero 𝕜 _ _ ?_
187:   rw [mul_smul_comm, proj_mul_H H hH, smul_zero]
188: 
189: theorem flow_mul_proj (u : 𝕜) : flow H u * reading H = reading H := by
190:   refine exp_mul_eq_of_mul_eq_zero 𝕜 _ _ ?_
191:   rw [smul_mul_assoc, H_mul_proj H, smul_zero]
192: 
193: include hH in
194: /-- P T_s = P. -/
195: theorem proj_mul_T (s : ℝ) : reading H * T H s = reading H := proj_mul_flow H hH _
196: 
197: include hH in
198: /-- A conservacao da leitura: I(T_s x) = I(x). -/
199: theorem reading_T (s : ℝ) (x : E) : reading H (T H s x) = reading H x := by
200:   rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply, proj_mul_T H hH]
201: 
202: /-- O setor da familia fica parado: z ∈ F ⟹ T_s z = z. -/
203: theorem T_fix_of_mem_ker (s : ℝ) {z : E} (hz : z ∈ H.ker) : T H s z = z := by
204:   have hPz : reading H z = z := Submodule.starProjection_eq_self_iff.2 hz
205:   have := congrArg (fun A : E →L[𝕜] E => A z) (flow_mul_proj H (s : 𝕜))
206:   simp only [ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply, hPz] at this
207:   exact this
208: 
209: /-- A decomposicao T_s x = P x + T_s (x − P x): a componente da familia permanece. -/
210: theorem T_decomp (s : ℝ) (x : E) :
211:     T H s x = reading H x + T H s (x - reading H x) := by
212:   have hP : T H s (reading H x) = reading H x :=
213:     T_fix_of_mem_ker H s (H.ker.starProjection_apply_mem x)
214:   rw [map_sub, hP, add_sub_cancel]
215: 
216: end Flow

218: /-! ## (4b) O veredito: V_x(T_s x) = 1, e a ponte com `NameInstrument.Verifies` (v336) -/
219: 
220: section Verdict
221: 
222: open Classical in
223: /-- V_r(y) = 1 se I(y) = I(r), 0 caso contrario (o criterio da secao 1 do texto). -/
224: noncomputable def verdict {X Y : Type*} (I : X → Y) (r y : X) : ℤ := if I y = I r then 1 else 0
225: 
226: variable {𝕜 E : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E]
227:   [CompleteSpace E]
228: 
229: /-- V_x(T_s x) = 1: a transformacao efetiva e verificada pela leitura da familia. -/
230: theorem verdict_T (H : E →L[𝕜] E) (hH : IsSelfAdjoint H) [H.ker.HasOrthogonalProjection]
231:     (s : ℝ) (x : E) : verdict (fun y => reading H y) x (T H s x) = 1 := by
232:   simp [verdict, reading_T H hH s x]
233: 
234: /-- O veredito binario e o bit da verdade: verdict ∈ {0,1} e vale 1 sse as leituras coincidem. -/
235: theorem verdict_eq_one_iff {X Y : Type*} (I : X → Y) (r y : X) :
236:     verdict I r y = 1 ↔ I y = I r := by
237:   unfold verdict; split_ifs with h <;> simp [h]
238: 
239: end Verdict

241: section NameBridge
242: 
243: variable {𝕜 : Type*} {E : Type} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E]
244:   [CompleteSpace E]
245: 
246: /-- Ponte com a folha v336 da arvore (`TGLExt.NameInstrument.Verifies`, read (f x) = read x):
247:     a leitura P e um Nome que VERIFICA cada T_s, e (pela folha) toda iterada de T_s. -/
248: theorem name_verifies_T (H : E →L[𝕜] E) (hH : IsSelfAdjoint H) [H.ker.HasOrthogonalProjection]
249:     (s : ℝ) :
250:     (⟨fun x => reading H x⟩ : TGLExt.NameInstrument E E).Verifies (fun x => T H s x) :=
251:   fun x => reading_T H hH s x
252: 
253: theorem name_verifies_T_iterate (H : E →L[𝕜] E) (hH : IsSelfAdjoint H)
254:     [H.ker.HasOrthogonalProjection] (s : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
255:     (⟨fun x => reading H x⟩ : TGLExt.NameInstrument E E).Verifies ((fun x => T H s x)^[n]) :=
256:   TGLExt.name_verifies_iterate _ (name_verifies_T H hH s) n
257: 
258: end NameBridge

260: /-! ## (5) Memoria estavel: Im P = Fix P, P^n = P, Px = Py ↔ x − y ∈ ker P -/
261: 
262: section Idempotent
263: 
264: variable {R M : Type*} [Semiring R] [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M]
265: 
266: theorem mem_range_iff_fixed (P : M →ₗ[R] M) (hP : IsIdempotentElem P) (z : M) :
267:     z ∈ LinearMap.range P ↔ P z = z := by
268:   constructor
269:   · rintro ⟨x, rfl⟩
270:     rw [← Module.End.mul_apply, hP.eq]
271:   · intro h
272:     exact ⟨z, h⟩
273: 
274: theorem pow_eq_self (P : M →ₗ[R] M) (hP : IsIdempotentElem P) {n : ℕ} (hn : n ≠ 0) :
275:     P ^ n = P := hP.pow_eq hn
276: 
277: theorem apply_eq_apply_iff (P : M →ₗ[R] M) (x y : M) :
278:     P x = P y ↔ x - y ∈ LinearMap.ker P := by
279:   rw [LinearMap.mem_ker, map_sub, sub_eq_zero]
280: 
281: /-- Instanciado na leitura: Im P = Fix P para a projecao ortogonal. -/
282: theorem starProjection_range_iff_fixed {𝕜 E : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E]
283:     [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E] (K : Submodule 𝕜 E) [K.HasOrthogonalProjection] (z : E) :
284:     z ∈ LinearMap.range (K.starProjection : E →ₗ[𝕜] E) ↔ K.starProjection z = z :=
285:   by
286:   have hid : IsIdempotentElem (K.starProjection : E →ₗ[𝕜] E) := by
287:     show (K.starProjection : E →ₗ[𝕜] E) * (K.starProjection : E →ₗ[𝕜] E) = K.starProjection
288:     ext x
289:     exact congrArg (fun A : E →L[𝕜] E => A x) K.isIdempotentElem_starProjection
290:   exact mem_range_iff_fixed _ hid z
291: 
292: end Idempotent

294: /-! ## (6) A reciproca: leitura continua conservada ⟺ l = l ∘ P (com o limite NOMEADO) -/
295: 
296: section Converse
297: 
298: /-- Hipotese NOMEADA: o semigrupo converge (ponto a ponto) para a projecao da familia. -/
299: def FlowTendsToFamily {X : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] (Tf : ℝ → X → X) (P : X → X) : Prop :=
300:   ∀ x, Tendsto (fun s => Tf s x) atTop (𝓝 (P x))
301: 
302: /-- Abstrata: com P ∘ T_s = P (s ≥ 0) e o limite nomeado, uma leitura continua e conservada
303:     ao longo do semigrupo sse fatora pela familia: l = l ∘ P. -/
304: theorem conserved_iff_factors {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y]
305:     [T2Space Y] (Tf : ℝ → X → X) (P : X → X) (hPT : ∀ s, 0 ≤ s → ∀ x, P (Tf s x) = P x)
306:     (hlim : FlowTendsToFamily Tf P) (l : X → Y) (hl : Continuous l) :
307:     (∀ s, 0 ≤ s → ∀ x, l (Tf s x) = l x) ↔ ∀ x, l x = l (P x) := by
308:   constructor
309:   · intro hc x
310:     have h1 : Tendsto (fun s => l (Tf s x)) atTop (𝓝 (l (P x))) :=
311:       (hl.tendsto _).comp (hlim x)
312:     have h2 : Tendsto (fun s => l (Tf s x)) atTop (𝓝 (l x)) := by
313:       refine tendsto_const_nhds.congr' ?_
314:       filter_upwards [eventually_ge_atTop (0 : ℝ)] with s hs
315:       exact (hc s hs x).symm
316:     exact tendsto_nhds_unique h2 h1
317:   · intro hf s hs x
318:     rw [hf (Tf s x), hPT s hs x, ← hf x]
319: 
320: variable {𝕜 E : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E]
321:   [CompleteSpace E]
322: 
323: /-- Instanciada no semigrupo da seletora. -/
324: theorem conserved_iff_factors_T (H : E →L[𝕜] E) (hH : IsSelfAdjoint H)
325:     [H.ker.HasOrthogonalProjection]
326:     (hlim : FlowTendsToFamily (fun s x => T H s x) (fun x => reading H x))
327:     {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y] (l : E → Y) (hl : Continuous l) :
328:     (∀ s, 0 ≤ s → ∀ x, l (T H s x) = l x) ↔ ∀ x, l x = l (reading H x) :=
329:   conserved_iff_factors (fun s x => T H s x) (fun x => reading H x)
330:     (fun s _ x => reading_T H hH s x) hlim l hl
331: 
332: end Converse

334: /-! ## (7) A derivada da leitura se anula; a da dinamica, nao necessariamente -/
335: 
336: section Derivative
337: 
338: variable {𝕜 E : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E]
339:   [CompleteSpace E]
340: variable (H : E →L[𝕜] E) (hH : IsSelfAdjoint H) [H.ker.HasOrthogonalProjection]
341: 
342: include hH in
343: /-- d/du P(flow u x) = 0 (parametro em 𝕜; para 𝕜 = ℝ e literalmente d/ds). -/
344: theorem hasDerivAt_reading_flow (x : E) (u : 𝕜) :
345:     HasDerivAt (fun v : 𝕜 => reading H (flow H v x)) 0 u := by
346:   have : (fun v : 𝕜 => reading H (flow H v x)) = fun _ => reading H x := by
347:     funext v
348:     rw [← ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply, proj_mul_flow H hH]
349:   rw [this]
350:   exact hasDerivAt_const _ _
351: 
352: include hH in
353: /-- A forma literal em s ∈ ℝ: d/ds P(T_s x) = 0 (qualquer estrutura real em E serve: a funcao
354:     e constante por `reading_T`). -/
355: theorem hasDerivAt_reading_T [NormedSpace ℝ E] (x : E) (s : ℝ) :
356:     HasDerivAt (fun r : ℝ => reading H (T H r x)) 0 s := by
357:   have : (fun r : ℝ => reading H (T H r x)) = fun _ => reading H x :=
358:     funext fun r => reading_T H hH r x
359:   rw [this]
360:   exact hasDerivAt_const _ _
361: 
362: /-- A dinamica inteira: d/du flow u = (−H) · flow u. -/
363: theorem hasDerivAt_flow (u : 𝕜) :
364:     HasDerivAt (fun v : 𝕜 => flow H v) ((-H) * flow H u) u := by
365:   have h := hasDerivAt_exp_smul_const' (𝕂 := 𝕜) (-H) u
366:   have e : ∀ v : 𝕜, (-v) • H = v • (-H) := fun v => by rw [neg_smul, smul_neg]
367:   simp only [flow, e]
368:   exact h
369: 
370: /-- Aplicada a x: d/du flow u x = −H (flow u x). -/
371: theorem hasDerivAt_flow_apply (x : E) (u : 𝕜) :
372:     HasDerivAt (fun v : 𝕜 => flow H v x) (-(H (flow H u x))) u := by
373:   have h := (hasDerivAt_flow H u).clm_apply (hasDerivAt_const u x)
374:   simpa using h
375: 
376: /-- Dinamica nao nula: fora da familia, a derivada em u = 0 e −H x ≠ 0,
377:     enquanto a derivada da leitura e 0. -/
378: theorem flow_derivative_ne_zero_at_zero (x : E) (hx : x ∉ H.ker) :
379:     HasDerivAt (fun v : 𝕜 => flow H v x) (-(H x)) 0 ∧ -(H x) ≠ 0 := by
380:   refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
381:   · have h := hasDerivAt_flow_apply H x 0
382:     simpa [flow, NormedSpace.exp_zero] using h
383:   · intro h0
384:     exact hx (LinearMap.mem_ker.2 (neg_eq_zero.1 h0))
385: 
386: end Derivative

388: /-! ## (8) O limite espectral em dimensao finita: exp(−sH) x → P x (s → ∞)
389:   Descarrega a hipotese nomeada `FlowTendsToFamily` quando E e de dimensao finita e H ≥ 0. -/
390: 
391: section Limit
392: 
393: /- `[CompleteSpace E]` e redundante sob `[FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E]` (`FiniteDimensional.complete`);
394:    fica explicito so para as instancias. -/
395: variable {𝕜 E : Type*} [RCLike 𝕜] [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E]
396:   [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E] [CompleteSpace E]
397: 
398: /-- exp age num autovetor como a exponencial escalar do autovalor. -/
399: theorem exp_apply_of_eigen (A : E →L[𝕜] E) (μ : 𝕜) (v : E) (hv : A v = μ • v) :
400:     NormedSpace.exp A v = NormedSpace.exp μ • v := by
401:   have hpow : ∀ n : ℕ, (A ^ n) v = μ ^ n • v := by
402:     intro n
403:     induction n with
404:     | zero => simp
405:     | succ n ih =>
406:       rw [pow_succ', ContinuousLinearMap.mul_apply, ih, map_smul, hv, smul_smul, ← pow_succ]
407:   have h1 := (NormedSpace.exp_series_hasSum_exp' (𝕂 := 𝕜) A).mapL
408:     (ContinuousLinearMap.apply 𝕜 E v)
409:   have h2 := (NormedSpace.exp_series_hasSum_exp' (𝕂 := 𝕜) μ).smul_const v
410:   refine h1.unique ?_
411:   convert h2 using 1
412:   funext n
413:   simp [hpow, smul_smul]
414: 
415: /-- No autovetor de autovalor real ev: T_s v = e^{−s·ev} v. -/
416: theorem T_apply_eigen (H : E →L[𝕜] E) (ev : ℝ) (v : E) (hv : H v = (ev : 𝕜) • v) (s : ℝ) :
417:     T H s v = ((Real.exp (-(s * ev)) : ℝ) : 𝕜) • v := by
418:   have hA : ((-(s : 𝕜)) • H) v = ((-(s : 𝕜)) * (ev : 𝕜)) • v := by
419:     rw [ContinuousLinearMap.smul_apply, hv, smul_smul]
420:   rw [T, flow, exp_apply_of_eigen _ _ _ hA]
421:   congr 1
422:   have e1 : (-(s : 𝕜)) * (ev : 𝕜) = algebraMap ℝ 𝕜 (-(s * ev)) := by
423:     rw [RCLike.algebraMap_eq_ofReal]; push_cast; ring
424:   rw [e1, ← NormedSpace.algebraMap_exp_comm, RCLike.algebraMap_eq_ofReal, Real.exp_eq_exp_ℝ]
425: 
426: /-- ★ O limite espectral: para H auto-adjunto com forma nao-negativa, em dimensao finita,
427:     T_s x → P x quando s → ∞ (os modos zero ficam; os demais decaem como e^{−s·ev}). -/
428: theorem flowTendsToFamily_of_finiteDimensional (H : E →L[𝕜] E) (hH : IsSelfAdjoint H)
429:     (hpos : ∀ x, 0 ≤ RCLike.re ⟪x, H x⟫_𝕜) :
430:     FlowTendsToFamily (fun s x => T H s x) (fun x => reading H x) := by
431:   intro x
432:   have hsym : (H : E →ₗ[𝕜] E).IsSymmetric := hH.isSymmetric
433:   have hn : Module.finrank 𝕜 E = Module.finrank 𝕜 E := rfl
434:   set b := hsym.eigenvectorBasis hn with hb
435:   have hi : ∀ i, Tendsto (fun s => T H s (b i)) atTop (𝓝 (reading H (b i))) := by
436:     intro i
437:     set ev := hsym.eigenvalues hn i with hev
438:     have hv : H (b i) = (ev : 𝕜) • b i := hsym.apply_eigenvectorBasis hn i
439:     by_cases h0 : ev = 0
440:     · have hk : b i ∈ H.ker := by
441:         rw [LinearMap.mem_ker]
442:         have : H (b i) = 0 := by rw [hv, h0]; simp
443:         exact this
444:       have hP : reading H (b i) = b i := Submodule.starProjection_eq_self_iff.2 hk
445:       rw [hP]
446:       have hc : (fun s => T H s (b i)) = fun _ => b i := funext fun s => T_fix_of_mem_ker H s hk
447:       rw [hc]
448:       exact tendsto_const_nhds
449:     · have hpos_i : 0 < ev := by
450:         have h1 := hpos (b i)
451:         rw [hv, inner_smul_right, RCLike.re_ofReal_mul, inner_self_eq_norm_sq,
452:           b.orthonormal.1 i] at h1
453:         norm_num at h1
454:         exact lt_of_le_of_ne h1 (Ne.symm h0)
455:       have hP : reading H (b i) = 0 := by
456:         have h2 : reading H (H (b i)) = 0 := by
457:           have := congrArg (fun A : E →L[𝕜] E => A (b i)) (proj_mul_H H hH)
458:           simpa using this
459:         rw [hv, map_smul] at h2
460:         exact (smul_eq_zero.1 h2).resolve_left (by exact_mod_cast h0)
461:       rw [hP]
462:       have hc : (fun s => T H s (b i)) = fun s => ((Real.exp (-(s * ev)) : ℝ) : 𝕜) • b i :=
463:         funext fun s => T_apply_eigen H ev (b i) hv s
464:       rw [hc]
465:       have hexp : Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => Real.exp (-(s * ev))) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
466:         Real.tendsto_exp_neg_atTop_nhds_zero.comp (tendsto_id.atTop_mul_const hpos_i)
467:       have h3 := (((RCLike.continuous_ofReal (K := 𝕜)).tendsto 0).comp hexp).smul_const (b i)
468:       simpa using h3
469:   have hT : ∀ s, T H s x = ∑ i, b.repr x i • T H s (b i) := by
470:     intro s
471:     conv_lhs => rw [← b.sum_repr x]
472:     simp [map_sum, map_smul]
473:   have hPx : reading H x = ∑ i, b.repr x i • reading H (b i) := by
474:     conv_lhs => rw [← b.sum_repr x]
475:     simp [map_sum, map_smul]
476:   have hfun : (fun s => T H s x) = fun s => ∑ i, b.repr x i • T H s (b i) := funext hT
477:   show Tendsto (fun s => T H s x) atTop (𝓝 (reading H x))
478:   rw [hfun, hPx]
479:   exact tendsto_finsetSum _ fun i _ => (hi i).const_smul _
480: 
481: /-- ★ A reciproca INCONDICIONAL em dimensao finita, para a penalidade dos vinculos:
482:     uma leitura continua e conservada ao longo de T_s = exp(−s H_3L) sse l = l ∘ P. -/
483: theorem conserved_iff_factors_penalty {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (D : ι → E →L[𝕜] E)
484:     {Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace Y] [T2Space Y] (l : E → Y) (hl : Continuous l) :
485:     (∀ s, 0 ≤ s → ∀ x, l (T (penalty D) s x) = l x) ↔
486:       ∀ x, l x = l (reading (penalty D) x) := by
487:   refine conserved_iff_factors_T (penalty D) (isSelfAdjoint_penalty D)
488:     (flowTendsToFamily_of_finiteDimensional (penalty D) (isSelfAdjoint_penalty D) ?_) l hl
489:   intro x
490:   rw [re_inner_penalty]
491:   exact Finset.sum_nonneg fun j _ => sq_nonneg _
492: 
493: end Limit

495: /-! ## (9) O perfil hiperbolico a = sech(χ/2), q = tanh(χ/2)
496:   HOMONIMO: esta anulacao a'(0) = 0 e do perfil em χ; NAO e o zero modular K Ω = 0,
497:   nem a anulacao da leitura em (7). Nenhum lema aqui os liga. -/
498: 
499: section Profile
500: 
501: open Real
502: 
503: noncomputable def profA (χ : ℝ) : ℝ := (cosh (χ / 2))⁻¹
504: noncomputable def profQ (χ : ℝ) : ℝ := tanh (χ / 2)
505: 
506: theorem hasDerivAt_profA (χ : ℝ) :
507:     HasDerivAt profA (-(1 / 2) * profA χ * profQ χ) χ := by
508:   have hc : HasDerivAt (fun y => cosh (y / 2)) (sinh (χ / 2) * (1 / 2)) χ :=
509:     ((hasDerivAt_id' χ).div_const 2).cosh
510:   have hne : cosh (χ / 2) ≠ 0 := (cosh_pos _).ne'
511:   have h : HasDerivAt (fun y => (cosh (y / 2))⁻¹) (-(sinh (χ / 2) * (1 / 2)) / cosh (χ / 2) ^ 2) χ :=
512:     hc.inv hne
513:   have e : -(1 / 2) * profA χ * profQ χ = -(sinh (χ / 2) * (1 / 2)) / cosh (χ / 2) ^ 2 := by
514:     simp only [profA, profQ, tanh_eq_sinh_div_cosh]
515:     field_simp
516:   rw [e]
517:   exact h
518: 
519: theorem hasDerivAt_profQ (χ : ℝ) :
520:     HasDerivAt profQ ((1 / 2) * profA χ ^ 2) χ := by
521:   have hc : HasDerivAt (fun y => cosh (y / 2)) (sinh (χ / 2) * (1 / 2)) χ :=
522:     ((hasDerivAt_id' χ).div_const 2).cosh
523:   have hs : HasDerivAt (fun y => sinh (y / 2)) (cosh (χ / 2) * (1 / 2)) χ :=
524:     ((hasDerivAt_id' χ).div_const 2).sinh
525:   have hne : cosh (χ / 2) ≠ 0 := (cosh_pos _).ne'
526:   have h := hs.div hc hne
527:   have hfun : profQ = fun y => sinh (y / 2) / cosh (y / 2) := by
528:     funext y
529:     simp only [profQ, tanh_eq_sinh_div_cosh]
530:   have key : cosh (χ / 2) * (1 / 2) * cosh (χ / 2) - sinh (χ / 2) * (sinh (χ / 2) * (1 / 2))
531:       = 1 / 2 := by
532:     linear_combination (1 / 2 : ℝ) * cosh_sq_sub_sinh_sq (χ / 2)
533:   have e : (1 / 2) * profA χ ^ 2 = (cosh (χ / 2) * (1 / 2) * cosh (χ / 2)
534:       - sinh (χ / 2) * (sinh (χ / 2) * (1 / 2))) / cosh (χ / 2) ^ 2 := by
535:     rw [key]
536:     simp only [profA]
537:     field_simp
538:   rw [hfun, e]
539:   exact h
540: 
541: theorem profA_zero : profA 0 = 1 := by simp [profA]
542: theorem profQ_zero : profQ 0 = 0 := by simp [profQ]
543: 
544: /-- a'(0) = 0. -/
545: theorem profA_deriv_zero : deriv profA 0 = 0 := by
546:   rw [(hasDerivAt_profA 0).deriv, profQ_zero, mul_zero]
547: 
548: /-- q'(0) = 1/2. -/
549: theorem profQ_deriv_zero : deriv profQ 0 = 1 / 2 := by
550:   rw [(hasDerivAt_profQ 0).deriv, profA_zero]; norm_num
551: 
552: /-- a''(0) = −1/4. -/
553: theorem profA_second_deriv_zero : deriv (deriv profA) 0 = -(1 / 4) := by
554:   have hd : deriv profA = fun χ => -(1 / 2) * profA χ * profQ χ := by
555:     funext χ; exact (hasDerivAt_profA χ).deriv
556:   rw [hd]
557:   have h := (((hasDerivAt_profA 0).const_mul (-(1 / 2) : ℝ)).mul (hasDerivAt_profQ 0))
558:   have h' : HasDerivAt (fun χ => -(1 / 2) * profA χ * profQ χ)
559:       (-(1 / 2) * (-(1 / 2) * profA 0 * profQ 0) * profQ 0
560:         + -(1 / 2) * profA 0 * (1 / 2 * profA 0 ^ 2)) 0 := h
561:   rw [h'.deriv, profA_zero, profQ_zero]
562:   norm_num
563: 
564: end Profile
